name: Seifuku Paradise
source:
Main hero has a uniform fetish. His hobby is to cosplay, visit cosplay events and make photos of cute girls for a cosplay specialized journal. It's every cosplayer girl dream to have a feature article in such a journal. And they agree on different conditions set by the main character for such a beneficial publication...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角有制服癖。他的愛好是角色扮演、參加Cosplay活動，並替Cosplay專門雜誌拍攝可愛女孩的照片。每名Cosplay女孩都夢想在這種雜誌上刊登專題。為了爭取上雜誌的機會，她們同意主角提出的各種條件……

[來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
